## battery_size: found 51, not 47 (spec deviation, evidence-based)

Distinct case_ids in the corpus = **51** (15 mc + 9 pc + 12 dc + 15 sr), verified per model — every model covers all 51. The "141 = 47×3" arithmetic is a coincidence of **uneven reps**: Anthropic models ran dc cases at 2 reps (15×3 + 9×3 + 12×2 + 15×3 = 141); OpenRouter models ran 51×3 = 153. Since the approved definition is "number of distinct case_ids in the standard probe battery," I used 51 (derived live, never hardcoded). All reference figures scale by 51/47 (×1.0851).
